tools.name: parse_efatura
tools.description: Explains how to parse your own Turkish e-invoice. Parsing is paid per call with x402 on the REST endpoint POST https://efaturaoku.site/v1/parse ($0.01 in USDC on Base, failed parses are free). This tool does not charge and does not parse.

tools.name: efatura_demo
tools.description: Free. Returns the parse output for a fictional sample invoice so you can see the JSON format.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "parse_efatura" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Reads one Turkish e-invoice (e-Fatura/e-Arşiv, UBL-TR 1.2 XML) and returns invoice number, ETTN, dates, supplier/customer (name, VKN/TCKN, tax office), lines, taxes (KDV, ÖTV), withholdings (tevkifat), totals, and a list of consistency checks. Costs $0.01 per successfully parsed invoice; failed pars" → after: "Explains how to parse your own Turkish e-invoice. Parsing is paid per call with x402 on the REST endpoint POST https://efaturaoku.site/v1/parse ($0.01 in USDC on Base, failed parses are free). This tool does not charge and does not parse."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
